Distinct target identity: Asymmetric editorial spread: a substantial portrait and name above a facts column and a wider narrative column.
Exact layout and typography changes: Use a 38 × 51 mm portrait, 32 pt name, 11 pt body and 12.5 pt section headings. Use a 72 mm facts column, 8 mm gutter and remaining width for narrative. Render custom prompts above answers when the label would wrap beyond two lines. Keep education and career together; use fewer rules around narrative sections.
Artwork decision: Keep the unillustrated paper treatment; no new AI art. Distinguish from 31 with unequal columns and a serif-led identity block.
Pagination and continuation: Rebalance p2 by moving family and partner preferences together after education/career on p1, subject to measured fit. Do not preserve the current p1 packing merely to retain its page break.

Distinct target identity: Monochrome professional dossier with a large left portrait and a section-name rail.

Use 11 pt values, 9.5–10 pt labels and 10 pt rail headings. Stack long labels over values instead of forcing three narrow columns.
Artwork decision: Keep solid black rules and white paper; no AI image or decorative photo ring. Make this the only rail-led monochrome design.
Pagination and continuation: Keep education/career/personal details on p1 and personal narrative/family/preferences/contact on p2 if they fit at the new sizes. Give the continuation heading the same sans-serif voice.

Distinct target identity: Botanical essay: wide introduction followed by an asymmetric facts-and-family grid.

Put education and career in one reading group, rather than breaking them across pages. Reserve a 12 mm outer decorative lane and keep the body clear of it.
Artwork decision: Keep the supplied branch drawing, whose silhouette is clean, but use one 32–40 mm tall branch beside the opening identity block. Remove the miniature bottom-left duplicate. Repeat only a small leaf-shaped divider on p2, outside text.

Distinct target identity: Architectural portrait cover within a compact terracotta arch, followed by a warm two-column document.

Pagination and continuation: Keep the observed birth/family/custom/contact continuation grouping only if balanced after enlargement. Use a short clay rule on p2; never repeat the tall arch.

Distinct target identity: Navy architectural masthead with geometric stepped rules and a generous portrait.
Exact layout and typography changes: Use a 30–35 mm deep navy masthead with an ivory 30 pt name, and a 36 × 48 mm rectangular portrait overlapping only the masthead's reserved photo area. Keep the body on light paper at 11 pt. Use 12.5 pt headings and 8 mm column gutter.
Artwork decision: Replace the tiny raster corner with vector stepped corner lines and one 0.75 pt gold accent. Remove the photo ring. Use geometry to distinguish this from the simple navy section bars in 32.
Pagination and continuation: Redistribute the short final-page content into a deliberate two-page composition; do not shrink type to force one page. Continue navy section markers on p2 without another full masthead.

Distinct target identity: Literary letter with a prominent introductory paragraph and a narrow facts sidebar.
Exact layout and typography changes: Use a 36 × 48 mm portrait, 32 pt serif name, regular 12 pt introduction with 16 pt leading, and 11 pt body. Replace the full-width stacked facts with a 52 mm sidebar plus 8 mm gutter and 114 mm narrative region. Avoid bold body paragraphs.
Artwork decision: The supplied leaf is legible as an asset but misplaced. Move a 22–28 mm tall version beside the opening title or remove it; never reserve a blank vertical band for it. Keep ink/cream and literary typography.
Pagination and continuation: Target two pages for this exact sample. Move education/career into usable p1 space and bring the p3 sections onto p2. Use normal content flow rather than fixed section quotas.

Distinct target identity: Restrained geometric border document with paired traditional fact groups.

Artwork decision: Redraw the supplied loop motif as clean continuous vector geometry, 22–26 mm wide at two opposite corners. Do not assert regional authenticity from the filename alone. Keep corners away from footers by at least 5 mm.
Pagination and continuation: Eliminate the token continuation page by testing measured one-page flow at readable sizes; if it does not fit, produce two balanced pages with family/preferences/custom/contact together.

Distinct target identity: Centered red linework medallion above a symmetrical identity header and alternating section bands.
Exact layout and typography changes: Use one 24 mm medallion in a compact 30 mm identity strip, a 36 × 48 mm portrait without a ring, and 30 pt name. Use 11 pt body and 12.5 pt red headings. Build alternating full-width and paired sections rather than copying 05's column structure.
Artwork decision: Keep the red floral linework if its fine detail survives print; simplify it to fewer, stronger strokes if it breaks up. Use one small matching separator on p2. The files alone do not verify that the rosette is specifically Alpana.
Pagination and continuation: Keep career with education. Reserve p2 for family, narrative, preferences, custom section and contact, with natural flow and consistent spacing.

Distinct target identity: Textile-led vertical border with a right-aligned identity block and a structured single-column body.

Artwork decision: Use the supplied textile motif as a repeat tile rather than a page-sized transparent image. Preserve aspect ratio and consistent repeat scale. Use only a 20 mm tall strip segment on continuation pages.
Pagination and continuation: Retain the broadly sensible p1 facts/education/career and p2 family/personal narrative split, but enlarge labels and balance section gaps. Keep textile outside the text area.

Distinct target identity: Peacock-led stationery with a horizontal textile signature beneath the identity block.
Exact layout and typography changes: Use a 38 × 51 mm portrait, 30 pt name and 11 pt body. Give the education/career group a coherent position. Replace equal-width ruled boxes with a 62 mm facts column and wider narrative column.

Pagination and continuation: Move family/preferences/custom content onto p2 and career alongside education on p1 to rebalance. Retain a slim green-and-maroon rule on p2.

Distinct target identity: Landscape miniature vignette above a balanced heritage document.

Artwork decision: Keep the supplied pavilion's general silhouette; simplify tiny balustrades/foliage if they disappear. Crop transparent padding, not the structure. Do not enlarge it into a full-page palace background.
Pagination and continuation: Target two pages. Put personal, education and career on p1; family, narrative, birth details, preferences, custom content and contact on p2. Rebalance if the actual font metrics require it.

Distinct target identity: Devotional header with an intentional illustration zone and a clear professional identity block.
Exact layout and typography changes: Place the complete figure in a reserved 25 × 38 mm top-left area, with 6 mm clear space around it. Use a 36 × 48 mm user portrait at right and a 30 pt name as the dominant text. Keep the opening header within 62 mm and body at 11 pt.
Artwork decision: The extracted figure is recognizable and not proven malformed by this audit. Retain only after checking hands, flute and edges at final print size; replace with a simpler respectful illustration of the same subject if detail fails. Remove the miniature footer plant. Never put body text across the figure.
Pagination and continuation: Keep education/career adjacent. Use p2 for narrative/family/preferences/custom/contact with birth details placed by available space, without deleting user-entered fields.

Distinct target identity: Light lotus stationery with a wide personal narrative opening and narrow factual side column.

Pagination and continuation: Try one-page flow for the sample using the compact header; retain two pages only if readable fit requires it, then balance the content. Distinguish structurally from 12, not merely by removing Krishna.

Artwork decision: Remove the photo ring. No AI art is needed; use flat saffron geometry and a neutral paper background. Do not add religious symbols to create differentiation.

Distinct target identity: Devotional side illustration with a calm single-column biographical layout.

Artwork decision: Keep the supplied Rama illustration only if bow, hands, feet and outline remain clear. No specific anatomical error is established. Prefer a simpler illustration of the same subject if replacement is necessary. Never crop the figure to force alignment.
Pagination and continuation: Retain two pages with education/career on p1 and family/narrative/preferences on p2. Add a quiet olive continuation rule, without repeating the complete figure.

Distinct target identity: Archival biography with numbered sections and a warm parchment tone.

Artwork decision: No new AI artwork. Keep a nearly flat warm background and fine olive rules; avoid faux stains or added sacred imagery. Differentiate through archival typography and numbering.

Distinct target identity: Textile yoke across the header with a strong centered identity and paired body columns.

Artwork decision: Reuse the supplied repeat after cropping transparent padding and checking join seams. Do not stretch its embroidery stitches. Use a small matching separator on p2. The file does not establish traditional authenticity.
Pagination and continuation: Keep education/career together and rebalance p2 with family/narrative/preferences. No automatic addition of symbols; this base should work without one.

Distinct target identity: Compact invocation line above an asymmetrical textile header, with family narrative given more space.

Distinct target identity: Symmetrical formal Phulkari composition with a centered identity and a compact emblem.

Artwork decision: Keep one 8 mm textile header band and remove the edge-hugging footer strip. Render the emblem as a vector and test its inner detail at print size; do not AI-generate it.
Pagination and continuation: Use a two-page layout with p1 factual groups and p2 family/narrative/preferences/contact. Group related gallery variants transparently, while preserving distinct geometry if displayed as separate designs.

Pagination and continuation: Rebalance family/narrative/preferences on p2. Preserve supplied birth data; do not infer whether to include astrology from the template name. Use a small geometric rule on p2.

Distinct target identity: Tall lancet portrait panel paired with an introductory essay and a compact facts grid.

Pagination and continuation: Target two pages for the sample. Pull factual content into p1's unused space and merge p3 into p2. Continue one narrow lancet-line accent instead of another full frame.

Distinct target identity: Cross-led formal letterhead with a rectangular portrait and a wide biography column.

Pagination and continuation: Target two pages. This should be structurally different from 22 if retained as a standalone gallery tile; otherwise label it clearly as that template's cross variant.

Distinct target identity: Restrained lotus stationery with a compact emblem and a generous personal introduction.

Distinct target identity: Calm lotus-led biographical essay with education and career in a compact opening summary.

Distinct target identity: Wheel-centered formal letterhead with balanced factual and personal sections.

Pagination and continuation: Target two pages with no birth/contact-only third page. Keep all optional fields data-driven.

Distinct target identity: Education-led editorial profile with a prominent user portrait and a secondary commemorative portrait.

Pagination and continuation: Retain two pages but make heading treatment identical across them. Keep family/personal narrative together on p2 and include a clear continuation identity.

Distinct target identity: Contemporary civic editorial design with a blue sidebar and strong typography.

Distinct target identity: Commemorative blue letterhead with an intentional greeting and a wide narrative-led body.

Pagination and continuation: Use two balanced pages, carrying a short blue rule and name onto p2. Group this transparently with Equality Blue if it remains a greeting variant.

Distinct target identity: Pure typographic one-column introduction with a compact paired-facts block.

Pagination and continuation: Retain readable two-page flow if needed; balance after the facts block is compacted. Keep contact last, after the custom section, instead of interrupting the personal narrative.

Pagination and continuation: Keep two pages, preserve logical section groups, and add a 10 pt running name plus 9 pt page number. Show career/education near the identity block if the data supports it.

Pagination and continuation: Balance the two pages, add running identity/page numbers, and place custom narrative before contact. Remove unused vertical space through flow changes, not smaller text.

Distinct target identity: Formal symmetric title and portrait above a framed document with legible section bands.

Pagination and continuation: Rebalance two pages with factual groups on p1 and narrative/family on p2. Use a modest running name and numbered footer inside the frame.

Distinct target identity: High-contrast luxury typography with generous portrait and an understated side rule.

Distinct target identity: Peach botanical portrait layout with a compact top-left bouquet and a broad information area.

Pagination and continuation: Target two pages. Remove the repeated blank header reservation on p2/3 and merge p3 into p2. Add running identity/page counts. Keep the substantial photo rather than shrinking it.

Distinct target identity: Cool floral sidebar composition with a left-aligned name and a pale violet structural accent.

Distinct target identity: Airy blue asymmetric stationery with a large right portrait and a left-aligned information spine.

Distinct target identity: Warm amber horizontal botanical header with a clear two-column body.

Pagination and continuation: Target two balanced pages; move Everyday life before contact on p2. Verify the redesigned 38 and 39 remain distinguishable in grayscale through their layouts.

Distinct target identity: Clean slate dossier with a substantial portrait and one restrained top rule.

Artwork decision: The full-page raster is effectively a plain sheet plus stripe; replace it with CSS/vector background and rule. No AI artwork.
Pagination and continuation: Retain two pages, balance the groups and include continuation identity and page numbers. Keep a straightforward single-column form to distinguish it from 32's section panels.

Distinct target identity: Architectural blue double-line frame with disciplined inset typography.

Artwork decision: Replace the full-page raster frame with crisp geometric blue vectors and four simple stepped corners. Avoid ornamental grayscale filigree that reads like a different design style.

Distinct target identity: Centered floral crest around the opening name with a calm single-column biography.

Pagination and continuation: Keep two balanced pages with just a small floral divider on p2. Ensure the opening silhouette is different from the corner-driven 43.

Distinct target identity: Asymmetric garden composition with a large left portrait and a narrative opening.

Distinct target identity: Contemporary pink botanical design with a compact horizontal title and open sans-serif body.

Artwork decision: Keep the brighter pink blossom style but split it into independent top-corner branches and a low footer meadow. Do not use a fixed full-page background to define all content margins.
Pagination and continuation: Target two pages by recovering unused top/bottom space. Make this a clean left-aligned layout, distinct from 45's literary serif composition.

Distinct target identity: Soft floral letter with a serif name, a generous introduction and a compact facts sidebar.
Exact layout and typography changes: Use a 32 pt upright serif name, 12 pt regular serif intro, 11 pt body and 13 pt headings. Keep a 41 × 55 mm portrait, with a 54 mm facts sidebar and wide letter-style narrative area. Reserve italics for a short optional subtitle, not the main name.
